question: Should OpenClaw accept this private aggregate recovery-point contract now, before its caller and the RFC 0013 ownership split are approved?
rationale: The branch deliberately establishes a new state-recovery boundary with no current production caller; code review cannot determine whether the runtime-state owner should own the selected-agent inventory and acceptance semantics.

options.title: Approve the private foundation
options.body: Accept the proposed ownership split, contingent on concrete SQLite-provider proof at the current head.

options.title: Defer until the caller/RFC lands
options.body: Keep the contract out of main until the RFC and an owning capture or restore path establish the required product boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the private foundation
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed ownership split, contingent on concrete SQLite-provider proof at the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the RFC-linked recovery sequence and can route the proposed ownership contract to the relevant state and snapshot owners.
